summary: Phase 3 (ProofSystem) is scoped-green: lake build Cslib.Logics.Temporal.ProofSystem (585 jobs) succeeds. Axioms.lean/Derivation.lean/Derivable.lean needed no edits (verify-only, as planned). Instances.lean (the canary risk) was genuinely broken and required real repair, not just verification: seven instances (HasAxiomLeftMonoUntilG, LeftMonoSinceH, RightMonoUntil, RightMonoSince, ConnectFuture, ConnectPast, TemporalNecessitation) failed to elaborate. Root causes: (1) four mono-instance `by` blocks never `intro`'d the leading implicit {φ ψ χ}/{φ} binder, so `_` placeholders bound to disconnected fresh metavariables; (2) `DerivationTree.axiom [] _ (...) trivial` inside `let` bindings left the frame-class parameter `fc` unassigned when `trivial : True` was checked, so the always-true `h.minFrameClass ≤ fc` obligation could not close; (3) underscore formula placeholders (`classic_to_allFuture (_ → _)`, `connect_future _`) never unified with the (now-introduced) concrete φ/ψ/χ. Fixed by adding `intro`, pinning `(fc := Temporal.FrameClass.Base)` explicitly, writing concrete formula arguments instead of `_`, and replacing the broken imp_k-based derivation-tree gymnastics with the existing-but-previously-unused `hyp_syl` helper (hypothetical syllogism, already present in the file). tempNecPast's `InferenceSystem.rwConclusion` call (stuck instance-search on a metavariable-headed type) was replaced with a direct `▸` rewrite using already-proved swapTemporal lemmas. Also deleted `bridgeAllFutureAxiom`, an unused dead-code private helper that ended in a literal `sorry` (PM3 violation latent in the WIP; zero call sites, safe removal). No bridge-axiom content or the Instances.lean typeclass routing strategy (D1) was changed -- only the broken Lean elaboration plumbing around it. Only Instances.lean modified (51 insertions / 107 deletions net). 0 sorry, 0 new Lean axioms, 0 vacuous defs, 0 new lint-style long-line warnings. Notation 𝐆/𝐇 confirmed scoped directly to Formula.allFuture/allPast constructors (Formula.lean:173,175). Full-project lake exe checkInitImports / full lake build remain legitimately RED (build-exclusivity PM2/PM7) due to unrelated pre-existing breakage elsewhere in the tree (task 241 WIP, missing Concat.olean) -- out of scope for this phase.

continuation_context.notes: Phase 4 (Metalogic — Soundness + DenseSoundness, 4 axiom_sound arms) is next. Add arms allFuture_to_classic/classic_to_allFuture/allPast_to_classic/classic_to_allPast to Soundness.lean's axiom_sound match (:75), using the allFuture_iff/someFuture_iff idiom already used at :87,:267,:408. Read DenseSoundness.lean's match to see if it re-dispatches Base axioms to axiom_sound (no change) or re-matches (mirror the 4 arms). Scoped verification: lake build Cslib.Logics.Temporal.Metalogic.Soundness and lake build Cslib.Logics.Temporal.Metalogic.DenseSoundness green; lean_verify on axiom_sound shows no sorry, no new axioms. Full Temporal build remains legitimately RED until P9 (build-exclusivity, PM2) -- do not attempt full lake build before P9. Note from Phase 3: when writing DerivationTree.axiom calls inside let-bindings (not directly inside an expected-typed anonymous constructor ⟨...⟩), always pin (fc := ...) explicitly and give concrete Formula arguments instead of `_` -- leaving either as a placeholder can strand the elaborator on an unresolved metavariable even when the underlying proof obligation (e.g. minFrameClass ≤ fc) is trivially true. The `hyp_syl` private helper in Instances.lean (A→B, B→C gives A→C) is available and may be reusable elsewhere if a similar bridge-then-axiom composition pattern recurs in Soundness.lean.
